methods.annual: 12 finite months required; mean; incomplete years discarded
methods.significance: Hamed-Rao annual Mann-Kendall; lags 1..3; >=10 consecutive years
methods.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Yekutieli FDR q=.05 over testable cells
methods.paradox: At least 10% of testable cells in each FDR-supported direction
methods.proportions: Unweighted cell counts divided by testable cells; not land-area fractions

warnings: Exploratory screening, not causal inference; no spatial clustering requirement.
Annual sum is supported only for additive monthly amounts.
